rows.about: **list of**, followed by a type, is a sequence of values of

judgment.note: A list must contain values of the type after list of, in order. Replacing Root.directives[0].type with WrongDirective in an otherwise valid directive list is not reported. List shape and order have rules, but the prescribed record type is not checked.

rows.about: A type followed by **or null** is either a value of that typ

judgment.note: A type followed by or null requires either a value of that type or null. Null and correctly typed values pass, and null in a required field is reported, but Root.frontmatter with type WrongFrontmatter passes; the non-null branch is not required to have its prescribed type.

rows.about: Parentheses group a type: **list of (Identifier or null)** i

judgment.note: Parentheses apply or null to each element rather than to the list. A null list and an element that is no node are reported, but replacing an Identifier in FlowchartClickUrlStatement.ids by NumericLiteral with raw A and value null is not reported; the element is neither Identifier nor null.

rows.about: A node type name, such as **Identifier**, is a node of that

judgment.note: A node type name requires that exact node type. Replacing FlowchartVertex.id, whose type is Identifier, by NumericLiteral with raw A and value null is not reported. The shape check accepts a node of another known type at that field.

rows.about: Every field is set when the node is created and is never cha

judgment.note: The conditions are that every field is set at creation and that no field changes afterwards. checkTree sees the current tree, not its creation or modification history. Replacing Root.body after creation by an equal valid copy is not reported. Missing current fields are a different condition and their old test is removed.

rows.about: A child field whose value is a list may have null elements w

judgment.note: The permission to put null elements in a list is not a condition to break. The condition is that a tool walking the tree skips permitted null elements. checkTree has no rule about another tool visiting those elements. The valid comma-only click list with two null elements passes (passes a fractional number and the node and null elements of a parenthesized list); rejecting a null in a non-nullable list is a different condition and its old test is removed.

judgment.note: Shared leaf forms, fixed-word fields and arrow values have rules, but a diagram-specific literal and label must keep their diagram-specific types. Replacing FlowchartLiteral by Identifier with the same written name, or FlowchartLabel by StringLiteral with matching raw, value and closed, is not reported.

rows.about: Text that the author writes but that the diagram does not re

judgment.note: Authored unread text has a leaf node and its shape is checked, but checkTree has no rule deciding whether the parser must accept such text before proposing a rejection as a known divergence. It receives an already-built tree and never compares parser acceptance or the reason for rejection. Replacing the leaf by a string only breaks its field shape, not those acceptance conditions.
